# Professional Summary

::: summary
Applied Data Scientist specializing in high-throughput biological data and production
analytics systems with extensive experience designing end-to-end data workflows,
developing custom R packages, and building cloud-backed applications. Skilled in Python,
SQL, AWS, and statistical modeling, with a strong foundation in experimental design and
high-throughput data.
:::

# Experience

::: {.twocolentry right="Jan 2024--present"}
**Lead Data Scientist**, Priogen Corporation --- St.\ Paul, MN
:::

::: onecolentry
::: highlights
- Architected and deployed end-to-end **data analysis pipelines** to process
  high-throughput diagnostic datasets (up to 100 samples/week, ∼240k rows of time-series
  data/project), reducing analysis time from ∼4 hours to seconds.
- Led **full-stack** development of a **Python**-based **LIMS** (PriLIMS) using
  **Django**, automating client data intake, tracking, and reporting, eliminating
  10 hours/week of manual administrative work.
- Implemented cloud-based infrastructure on **AWS** to support scalable **SQL** storage
  and analysis, improving system reliability and enabling secure multi-user access.
- Introduced **Git**-based version control and **CI** workflows across projects,
  improving collaboration efficiency and significantly reducing deployment errors.
:::
:::

::: {.twocolentry right="Aug 2022--present"}
**Researcher IV**, MNPRO, University of Minnesota --- St.\ Paul, MN
:::

::: onecolentry
::: highlights
- Developed a custom **R** package and automation scripts to standardize RT-QuIC data
  analysis, reducing hours of analysis time to seconds and increasing reproducibility
  across collaborating labs.
- Streamlined **data processing** and reporting workflows using **R** and **Python**
  tools, reducing turnaround time for experimental results by **99%**.
- Built and evaluated **statistical models** to classify diagnostic outcomes, improving
  disease detection confidence.
- Standardized cross-lab analytics and built reusable analytical frameworks adopted by
  multiple institutions.
- Led laboratory establishment, expansion, and workflow redesign, increasing research
  capacity.
:::
:::
